title: 35mm film light-leak and prism burn wipe
blurb: One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas wipes between two live HTML scenes with a multi-octave FBM 35mm film light-leak, prism chroma offset, highlight halation and hit-box sync.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas wipe cleanly between two live HTML scenes using a multi-octave FBM film light-leak, prism RGB splitting and highlight halation while switching hit-testing at both endpoints?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160.0.8188.0 Canary (2026-11-27): 6/6 live checks pass (0.89 MP at 412 px DPR 2.625, 0.21 MP at desktop), Warm 35mm vs Prism cyan flips R/B ratios at 48%, and hit testing swaps cleanly at 0% and 100%. Chrome 159 on Android stays not verified.
